  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MAY 3, 2025

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Negrete at 8:05 a.m., on
  Saturday, May 3, 2025, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA, and a
  Teleconference Site in Washington, DC 20037.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Lana Negrete
  Mayor Pro Tem Caroline Torosis (arrived via teleconference at 8:05 a.m.)
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick (arrived at 8:05 a.m.)
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Also Present:  Interim City Manager Elaine Polachek
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 8:05 a.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember Zwick and Mayor Pro Tem
  Torosis. Councilmember Snell led the assemblage in the Pledge of
  Allegiance.

  STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica is located on the land of Tovangaar. With
  ACCOUNTABILITY  great respect, the City acknowledges the Gabrieleño/Tongva as the First
  (LAND  People of this ancestral and unceded territory of Kuruvungna, a village
  ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)  that we know as Santa Monica. We honor their elders, past and present,
  and the Gabrieleño descendants who are part of the Gabrieleño /Tongva
  tribes.

  We recognize that these peoples are still here, and as settlers and kuyam
  (guests), we recognize our responsibility and obligation to care for their
  land in partnership with them. The City of Santa Monica commits to
  work in partnership with the Gabrieleño/Tongva people to uplift their
  voices and visibility on their ancestral land.

  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember Hall.

  LEVINE ACT  Pursuant to the Levine Act (Govt Code Section 84308), any party to a
  DISCLOSURE  permit, license, contract, or other entitlement before the Council is
  required to disclose on the record any contribution, including
  aggregated contributions, of more than $500 made by the party or the
  party's agents within the preceding 12 months to any City official.
  Participants and agents are requested to make this disclosure as well.
  The disclosure must include the name of the party, participant, or agent,
  and any other person making the contribution; the name of the
  recipient, the amount of the contribution, and the date the contribution
  was made.

  No Councilmembers made any disclosures pursuant to the Levine Act.

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  No members of the public commented on Closed Session items.
  CLOSED SESSION ONLY:

  CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 8:08 a.m., to consider
  Closed Sessions and adjourned at 6:02 p.m., with no reportable action.
  (Mayor Pro Tem Torosis and
  Councilmember Zwick  5.A. Public employee appointment - Gov. Code § 54957(b): consider
  arrived at 8:05 a.m.)  public employee appointment; title: City Manager; Gov. Code §
  54957.6: conference with labor negotiator; City negotiator:
  Mayor/Personnel Director; unrepresented employee: City Manager

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 6:02 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Nikima S. Newsome  Lana Negrete
  City Clerk  Mayor

  2  May 3, 2025
